proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ F X hA hI
  refine ⟨MeasureTheory.martingalePart X F P, MeasureTheory.predictablePart X F P, MeasureTheory.martingale_martingalePart hA hI, MeasureTheory.predictablePart_zero, fun n => MeasureTheory.stronglyAdapted_predictablePart n, fun n => ?_, fun h => h.monotone_predictablePart⟩
  have := MeasureTheory.martingalePart_add_predictablePart F P X
  exact (congrFun this n).symm
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] (F : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ), MeasureTheory.StronglyAdapted F X → (∀ n, MeasureTheory.Integrable (X n) P) → ∃ (M A : ℕ → Ω → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Martingale M F P ∧ A 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ n, @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable Ω ℝ _ (F n) (A (n + 1))) ∧ (∀ n, X n = M n + A n) ∧ (MeasureTheory.Submartingale X F P → ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Monotone (fun n => A n ω))
